utterances.speaker: spk_2
utterances.text: Pellwyn Supply, this is Tomasz.

utterances.speaker: spk_1
utterances.text: Hi Tomasz, Sam from Vantrellis. Okay, let's get started.

utterances.speaker: spk_2
utterances.text: Sure.

utterances.speaker: spk_1
utterances.text: Today I'll walk you through how we work and then show you the product.

utterances.speaker: spk_2
utterances.text: Okay.

utterances.speaker: spk_1
utterances.text: Most teams we talk to struggle with dispatch, so let me show you how we fix that.

utterances.speaker: spk_2
utterances.text: Okay, go ahead.

utterances.speaker: spk_1
utterances.text: What would success look like by the end of the quarter?

utterances.speaker: spk_2
utterances.text: Get dispatch down to thirty minutes a day, and zero missed pickups.

utterances.speaker: spk_1
utterances.text: So let me walk you through the platform. There's the scheduling board, which has drag and drop, color coding, and templates. Then there's the mobile app, which works on iPhone and Android, with push alerts and offline mode. We also have reporting, with twelve standard reports and a custom report builder, and we integrate with payroll, accounting, and most CRMs. There's an admin console for permissions, single sign-on, audit logs, and we have a customer success team that does onboarding. We also just launched route optimization and a customer portal, and there's an API if your team wants to build anything custom. Most customers start with the scheduling board and then add modules as they grow.

utterances.speaker: spk_2
utterances.text: Right, and the thing that worries me is whether my

utterances.speaker: spk_1
utterances.text: Right, right, so that's exactly what our dispatch module handles.

utterances.speaker: spk_2
utterances.text: Okay. What does something like that cost?

utterances.speaker: spk_1
utterances.text: It's thirty thousand dollars a year. But honestly, if you sign this month I can take twenty percent off, so it's really a lot less than that.

utterances.speaker: spk_2
utterances.text: Okay. I'll have to think about it.

utterances.speaker: spk_1
utterances.text: Are you the one who makes the call on this?

utterances.speaker: spk_2
utterances.text: Me and Robin, mostly.

utterances.speaker: spk_1
utterances.text: Does what you've seen so far make sense for your team?

utterances.speaker: spk_2
utterances.text: Can you just send me some info and I'll look it over?

utterances.speaker: spk_1
utterances.text: Well, honestly, the info won't show you much. We're actually cheaper than most of the market.

utterances.speaker: spk_2
utterances.text: Okay. Send it anyway.

utterances.speaker: spk_1
utterances.text: I'll send over some info and you can let me know what you think.

utterances.speaker: spk_2
utterances.text: Sounds good.

utterances.speaker: spk_1
utterances.text: Thanks Tomasz, really appreciate the time.

utterances.speaker: spk_2
utterances.text: Thanks, bye.
